overall_scope: reproducible legacy-development campaign; independent scientific held-out claims remain blocked

classification_meanings.VERIFIED: The scoped statement is established by direct content, code or numerical evidence.
classification_meanings.PARTIALLY VERIFIED: Evidence supports only part of the statement or population; scope must remain explicit.
classification_meanings.UNRESOLVED: Available evidence cannot establish or refute the claim; a blocker and manuscript impact remain.
classification_meanings.INVALID: The stated affirmative claim conflicts with observed evidence or the meaning of the physical quantity.

claims.claim: A–D share exact input bytes, frozen state, source identity and evaluation IDs.
claims.evidence: Recomputed Git source aggregate and all manifest/artifact hashes; exact 378/81/82 IDs.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Supports a reproducible legacy campaign, not scientific certification.
claims.next_action: None for this scoped identity claim.

claims.claim: The numerical target is log10 of the CSV linear halo_mass in declared Msun.
claims.evidence: All redundant mass columns/group labels and C float32 graph targets agree.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Report RMSE in dex against the legacy logarithmic mass label.
claims.next_action: Retain explicit target identity with any reported score.

claims.claim: The legacy targets were intended as total M200c; full-catalog physical verification is incomplete.
claims.evidence: Fetcher selects Group_M_Crit200; exact raw matches for 20 rows in groups 0/1; 539 groups unavailable.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Do not state that every halo label is independently certified M200c.
claims.next_action: Obtain complete raw targets or authenticated acquisition records and compare all group IDs.

claims.claim: The pipeline predicts dark-matter-only halo mass.
claims.evidence: M200c is total enclosed matter; no DM-only target extraction exists.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Use total halo mass intended as M200c, with the partial-provenance caveat.
claims.next_action: A DM-only experiment needs a distinct target, dataset and newly trained model.

claims.claim: Legacy half_mass_radius is a stellar type-4 radius.
claims.evidence: Fetcher uses halfmassrad; both raw matched groups verify total SubhaloHalfmassRad instead.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Remove stellar-size/observable-only interpretations of this feature and old physics loss.
claims.next_action: Use an explicitly intrinsic study or a new audited type-4/observable dataset and compatible training.

claims.claim: Legacy metallicity is stellar metallicity.
claims.evidence: Fetcher uses gasmetallicity and raw gas values match after cleaning.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Describe gas metallicity; do not claim a stellar-metallicity measurement.
claims.next_action: Rebuild a distinct feature schema if stellar metallicity is scientifically intended.

claims.claim: Legacy velocity_dispersion is measured stellar LOS galaxy velocity dispersion.
claims.evidence: Raw SubhaloVelDisp is internal 1D dispersion of all member particle/cell types.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Do not call the legacy policy an observational kinematic selector.
claims.next_action: Use measured/projected bulk velocities in a separately trained observational pipeline.

claims.claim: Current node/edge feature code does not copy target labels into predictor inputs.
claims.evidence: Explicit four-node/five-edge schema; target used only as graph y and supervised training reward.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: This rules out a literal label column, not all leakage or training exposure; intrinsic features contain privileged simulation information.
claims.next_action: Recover original training inputs/membership; predefine observable versus intrinsic feature scope.

claims.claim: The final CSV has no exact duplicate rows or repeated subhalo IDs.
claims.evidence: 5378 unique IDs/rows, 541 groups; redundant targets consistent.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Stable-ID overlap is absent in this final catalog only.
claims.next_action: Keep new fail-closed loader assertions.

claims.claim: checkpoint.csv or clustered HDF5 adds independent observations.
claims.evidence: HDF5 matches all 18 final CSV columns; checkpoint.csv overlaps 4970 member IDs.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Never concatenate these as independent train/test data.
claims.next_action: Keep intermediates distinguished by identity and role.

claims.claim: The available raw_hdf5 directory is a complete authentic catalog.
claims.evidence: Two nonempty group chunks, nine empty chunks, one zero-byte invalid file; expected 448 chunks.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Full target/feature provenance cannot be certified from these files.
claims.next_action: Procure complete hash-verified raw catalogs; release authentication remains external.

claims.claim: Catalog selection completeness and representativeness are established.
claims.evidence: Capped/cleaned central-candidate API workflow; no full acquisition/failure accounting.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Mass/richness/galaxy-selection biases and missing satellites limit scientific population claims.
claims.next_action: Recover API selection/failure records and full member/halo selection accounting.

claims.claim: The graphs contain every subhalo of the most massive 600 halos.
claims.evidence: Fetcher caps ten members and filters; actual 541 groups, richness 7–10.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Describe selected capped FoF member lists, not complete halos or a representative survey.
claims.next_action: A complete-member experiment needs separately acquired and versioned inputs.

claims.claim: Current campaign computations apply declared ckpc/h-to-Mpc and log-stellar-to-linear conversions once at snapshot 99.
claims.evidence: Explicit unit declaration, source trace, graph targets and two-group raw matches.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Describe computational units; physical authentication outside matched rows remains partial.
claims.next_action: Use a new audited manifest for other epochs/semantics.

claims.claim: Current graphs are within-group Euclidean radius plus nearest-isolate fallback, reciprocal columns and self-loops.
claims.evidence: Rebuilt graph hashes agree with saved C rows; actual fallback pairs measured.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: This precise software graph definition is safe to report.
claims.next_action: Keep architectural loops separate from physical pair budgets.

claims.claim: Every graph edge is a correct physical neighbor within 2 Mpc.
claims.evidence: 215 minimum-image radius disagreements in 14 halos; five unordered fallback pairs exceed 2 Mpc.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Physical graph interpretation is materially wrong, including two test halos; preserve scores as legacy only.
claims.next_action: Use verified unwrapping or consistent periodic geometry, then retrain/evaluate in a new experiment.

claims.claim: Current evaluation splits are deterministic and member-disjoint for these bytes.
claims.evidence: Sorted cluster IDs, RandomState(42), exact manifest agreement and zero cross-split member overlap.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Supports evaluation-population identity but not historical training separation.
claims.next_action: Preserve dataset hash, split IDs and algorithm with results.

claims.claim: The original and current preprocessing can be treated as identical.
claims.evidence: Archived loader changes 1389 positions, 12 stellar masses and one radius; six test graph edge sets change.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Older 0.1167 and current 0.114797 scores need separate preprocessing identities.
claims.next_action: Train fresh compatible weights for corrected scientific semantics; do not rewrite historical results.

claims.claim: Historical augmentation was executed exclusively on training parents.
claims.evidence: Notebook source splits first and adds three views to 378 train graphs; no durable executed lineage.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Intended 1512/81/82 recipe is supported; absence of historical view leakage is not certified.
claims.next_action: Recover original parent/transform manifests or use a new provenance-complete training run.

claims.claim: Historical augmentation is a physically covariant phase-space transformation with rebuilt neighbors.
claims.evidence: Positions rotate/jitter; velocities and original topology remain unchanged.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Do not claim physical rotational invariance or a controlled augmentation benefit.
claims.next_action: Use joint transforms and explicit graph reconstruction in a separate compatible experiment.

claims.claim: Independent held-out evaluation of the original backbone is demonstrable.
claims.evidence: Checkpoint stores no training catalog hash, source revision, split IDs or augmentation lineage; notebook/log agreement is supporting evidence only.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: No independently certified unseen-halo accuracy may be claimed from these weights; contamination is neither proven nor excluded.
claims.next_action: Recover checkpoint-bound original training evidence or train a fresh model on audited independent groups.

claims.claim: The existing halo split establishes independent-volume or independent-IC generalization.
claims.evidence: All halos derive from a single TNG100 box and test results have been repeatedly inspected.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Limit results to same-volume development evaluation.
claims.next_action: Reserve new independent IC/volume catalogs for predeclared confirmation.

claims.claim: The A–D frozen checkpoint is identified and consistent across stages.
claims.evidence: File 42764f0d... and tensor-state 56907374... match exact input and stage records.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Supports artifact identity, not how the weights were trained.
claims.next_action: Keep file/state hashes distinct and Stage B separately labelled.

claims.claim: Legacy policy uses intrinsic edges, frozen endpoint embeddings and mean context.
claims.evidence: EdgePolicyNet, prepare_graphs and pair-training code; five-edge/four-node schema.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Describe an intrinsic simulation-feature selector.
claims.next_action: Maintain schema compatibility checks for any new policy.

claims.claim: The RL reward measures calibrated total-halo virial equilibrium.
claims.evidence: Relative stellar/internal-dispersion degree-weighted proxy with Euclidean distances and reciprocal PE terms.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Use the explicit proxy formula; no equilibrium/causal dark-matter mechanism claim.
claims.next_action: Validate a physically justified objective and ablate it on independent data.

claims.claim: The policy physics proxy is empirically calibrated and causally improves performance.
claims.evidence: Implementation is dimensionally interpretable but no controlled causal/physical calibration is supplied.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Cannot attribute accuracy to physical fidelity or report the proxy as measured binding energy.
claims.next_action: Run predeclared physics and feature ablations with real independent groups.

claims.claim: The completed RL policy is a projected-observable policy.
claims.evidence: Embeddings inherit intrinsic all-particle dispersion and total radius; reward requires unavailable intrinsic fields.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: No real-observation or projected-policy transfer result is established.
claims.next_action: Develop a justified projected objective/trainer and newly trained compatible artifacts; never fabricate fields.

claims.claim: The current D adaptation reward has no target-label argument.
claims.evidence: label_free_reward and TTA use uncertainty plus retention/connectivity/relative-proxy terms.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Safe as an implementation property, not evidence of calibration, accuracy improvement or backbone independence.
claims.next_action: Retain validation-only K selection and separately validate objective utility.

claims.claim: Saved C full/nominal-q40 RL RMSE are 0.11479669852430192 and 0.13616044859036275 dex on 82 common test graphs.
claims.evidence: Saved per-example arithmetic, matching targets/graph hashes, same IDs and checkpoint; CPU replay agrees numerically.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Report as legacy-development measurements with the held-out/target/geometry limitations.
claims.next_action: Retain frozen reference and score identities.

claims.claim: The current campaign establishes general RL superiority or accuracy preservation.
claims.evidence: Full graph is more accurate; one fitted policy seed and inspected development test population.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Explicitly report that current evidence does not establish RL superiority.
claims.next_action: Predeclare comparisons and replicate fresh independent training/test groups.

claims.claim: A corrected independently held-out projected baseline and compatible policy have been trained.
claims.evidence: Separate audited baseline code exists; no real independent catalog manifest or new scientific run is available; projected RL trainer absent.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: New science cannot inherit legacy scores.
claims.next_action: Execute config/paper-provenance-baseline.example.yaml on real audited independent ICs into a new output directory; design projected RL separately.

claims.claim: The current sparse pipeline establishes practical speedup and calibrated uncertainty.
claims.evidence: This provenance audit preserves cost/calibration artifacts but does not supply independent efficiency/calibration experiments.
claims.impact_on_manuscript: Edge retention and broad MC-dropout intervals cannot justify general efficiency/calibration claims.
claims.next_action: Measure synchronized complete inference costs and independently calibrate/assess uncertainty on new evaluation populations.

Correct periodic geometry and physically consistent features/augmentation for a new scientific run
Real independent IC/volume catalogs and new compatible trained baseline
Justified projected policy objective/trainer and new artifacts
